_comment: Casalrana's entry on the travel map and its look. Off the map until rice_village_revealed is set, when the bus line reaches it (nothing sets it yet); tests and screenshots reach it with --island=rice_village. look.weather: always clear (late November, bright white skies).
name: Casalrana
desc: A hamlet out on the rice plain after the harvest: frosty stubble, herons in the ditches, and a little station where the trains stopped stopping in 1993.
